name: Lucem
description: Lucem were a species of humanoids found in the galaxy. Lucem were distinguishable by their nearly-translucent pale skin, white hair, and unique eyes. A Lucem's eyes were fully black with many small white pupils. The Lucem had control over their many pupils, which they could move around their eyes as a defense mechanism to cause vertigo in individuals perceived as a threat.

data.name: Lucem
data.eyecolor: Black iris and sclera, with many white pupils
